name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: Annex A of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 lists 93 information security controls grouped into four themes. The wording below is a paraphrased summary written for this project; the authoritative text remains the published standard.

themes.name: Organizational controls
themes.description: Governance, policy, supplier, incident and compliance controls that direct how the organisation manages information security.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.purpose: Give management direction and support for information security.
controls.description: An information security policy and supporting topic-specific policies are defined, approved by management, published and acknowledged by relevant staff, and reviewed at planned intervals or after significant change.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.purpose: Establish a clear structure of accountability for security work.
controls.description: Security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated according to the organisation's needs, so that every activity has a named owner.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.purpose: Reduce the risk of fraud, error and unauthorised change.
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are separated so that no single person can complete a sensitive process without oversight.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.purpose: Ensure security is applied consistently across the organisation.
controls.description: Management requires all personnel to apply information security in line with the established policies, topic-specific policies and procedures.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.purpose: Maintain a route to regulators and emergency services.
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities are established and maintained so incidents and legal obligations can be handled promptly.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.purpose: Stay informed about emerging threats and good practice.
controls.description: Contact is maintained with special interest groups, security forums and professional associations relevant to the organisation.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.purpose: Understand the threats the organisation actually faces.
controls.description: Information about information security threats is collected and analysed to produce intelligence that informs protective and detective measures.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.purpose: Build security into new work rather than adding it later.
controls.description: Information security requirements are identified and addressed within project management, regardless of the type of project.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.purpose: Know what has to be protected and who owns it.
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, is developed and kept up to date.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.purpose: Set expectations for how staff may use organisational assets.
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use and handling of information and associated assets are identified, documented and implemented.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.purpose: Recover organisational property when access ends.
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties return all organisational assets in their possession when their employment, contract or agreement ends.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.purpose: Apply protection proportionate to sensitivity.
controls.description: Information is classified according to confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested-party requirements.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.purpose: Make the classification of information visible to handlers.
controls.description: Procedures for labelling information are developed and implemented in line with the adopted classification scheme.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.purpose: Protect information while it moves between parties.
controls.description: Transfer rules, procedures and agreements are in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organisation and with external parties.

controls.title: Access control
controls.purpose: Limit access to information to those who need it.
controls.description: Rules controlling physical and logical access to information and associated assets are established and implemented based on business and security requirements.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.purpose: Maintain trustworthy identities for people and services.
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities is managed, from creation through change to removal.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.purpose: Protect the secrets that prove identity.
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information is controlled by a management process that includes advising personnel on appropriate handling.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.purpose: Keep granted access aligned with current duties.
controls.description: Access rights to information and associated assets are provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the access control policy.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.purpose: Manage the risk introduced by third parties.
controls.description: Processes and procedures are defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier products or services.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.purpose: Make security obligations contractual.
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements are established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of relationship.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.purpose: Address risk that arrives through products and components.
controls.description: Processes and procedures are defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.purpose: Keep assurance current over the life of a contract.
controls.description: The organisation regularly monitors, reviews, evaluates and manages change to supplier information security practice and service delivery.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.purpose: Govern cloud adoption and exit.
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services are established in accordance with the organisation's security requirements.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.purpose: Be ready before an incident happens.
controls.description: Incident management processes, roles and responsibilities are planned and prepared in advance and communicated to those involved.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.purpose: Separate real incidents from routine events.
controls.description: Information security events are assessed and a decision is taken on whether they are to be categorised as information security incidents.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.purpose: Contain and resolve incidents consistently.
controls.description: Information security incidents are responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.purpose: Stop the same incident happening twice.
controls.description: Knowledge gained from incidents is used to strengthen and improve information security controls.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.purpose: Preserve material that may be needed later.
controls.description: Procedures are established for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.purpose: Keep protection in place when normal operations fail.
controls.description: The organisation plans how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.purpose: Ensure technology can support continuity objectives.
controls.description: ICT readiness is planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.purpose: Know and meet the obligations that apply.
controls.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security, and the approach to meeting them, are identified, documented and kept up to date.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.purpose: Respect licensing and ownership of material.
controls.description: Appropriate procedures are implemented to protect intellectual property rights.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.purpose: Keep records intact for as long as they are required.
controls.description: Records are protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access and unauthorised release.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information
controls.purpose: Meet privacy obligations for personal data.
controls.description: The organisation identifies and meets the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of personally identifiable information according to applicable law and contracts.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.purpose: Obtain objective assurance over the ISMS.
controls.description: The organisation's approach to managing information security and its implementation is reviewed independently at planned intervals and when significant change occurs.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.purpose: Confirm that the rules are actually followed.
controls.description: Compliance with the organisation's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards is regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.purpose: Make routine operations repeatable and reviewable.
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities are documented and made available to the personnel who need them.

themes.name: People controls
themes.description: Controls covering the security responsibilities of individuals before, during and after employment.

controls.title: Screening
controls.purpose: Verify candidates before granting access.
controls.description: Background verification checks on candidates are carried out before joining and on an ongoing basis, proportionate to business requirements, classification of information accessed and perceived risk.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.purpose: Make security responsibilities part of the agreement.
controls.description: Employment contracts state the personnel's and the organisation's responsibilities for information security.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.purpose: Give people the knowledge to work securely.
controls.description: Personnel and relevant interested parties receive appropriate awareness, education and training, plus regular updates to policies and procedures relevant to their role.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.purpose: Provide a consistent consequence for violations.
controls.description: A disciplinary process is formalised and communicated so action can be taken against personnel and other parties who have committed an information security policy violation.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.purpose: Ensure obligations survive a role change.
controls.description: Information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment are defined, enforced and communicated.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.purpose: Formalise the duty to keep information private.
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organisation's needs are identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant parties.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.purpose: Protect information accessed away from the office.
controls.description: Security measures are implemented when personnel work remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organisation's premises.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.purpose: Surface problems quickly through a known channel.
controls.description: A mechanism is provided for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events in a timely manner.

themes.name: Physical controls
themes.description: Controls protecting premises, equipment and physical media from unauthorised access, damage and interference.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.purpose: Define and defend the boundary of secure areas.
controls.description: Security perimeters are defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.purpose: Allow only authorised people into secure areas.
controls.description: Secure areas are protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.purpose: Apply physical protection to working areas.
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities is designed and implemented.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.purpose: Detect unauthorised physical access.
controls.description: Premises are continuously monitored for unauthorised physical access.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.purpose: Reduce the impact of fire, flood and similar hazards.
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, whether natural or intentional, is designed and implemented.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.purpose: Control behaviour inside sensitive locations.
controls.description: Security measures for working in secure areas are designed and implemented.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.purpose: Prevent casual exposure of information.
controls.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media, and clear screen rules for information processing facilities, are defined and enforced.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.purpose: Place equipment where it is least exposed.
controls.description: Equipment is sited securely and protected from environmental and physical risks.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.purpose: Protect equipment taken outside the organisation.
controls.description: Assets located away from the organisation's premises are protected in a way that reflects the different risks involved.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.purpose: Control media through its whole life.
controls.description: Storage media is managed through its life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the classification scheme and handling requirements.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.purpose: Keep power and other utilities from becoming a single point of failure.
controls.description: Information processing facilities are protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.purpose: Protect the physical layer of the network.
controls.description: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services are protected from interception, interference and damage.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.purpose: Keep equipment working and secure.
controls.description: Equipment is maintained correctly to ensure the availability, integrity and confidentiality of the information it holds.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.purpose: Ensure retired equipment leaks nothing.
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media are verified to ensure that sensitive data and licensed software have been removed or securely overwritten before disposal or re-use.

themes.name: Technological controls
themes.description: Technical controls applied to systems, networks, applications and data.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.purpose: Protect information on laptops, desktops and mobile devices.
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices is protected.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.purpose: Tightly control powerful accounts.
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.purpose: Enforce need-to-know inside applications.
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets is restricted in accordance with the established access control policy.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.purpose: Protect the integrity of software being built.
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries is appropriately managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.purpose: Make sign-in resistant to misuse.
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented based on information access restrictions and the access control policy.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.purpose: Ensure resources meet demand.
controls.description: The use of resources is monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.purpose: Prevent and detect malicious software.
controls.description: Protection against malware is implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.purpose: Find and fix weaknesses before they are exploited.
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of systems in use is obtained, the organisation's exposure is evaluated and appropriate measures are taken.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.purpose: Keep systems in a known, secure state.
controls.description: Configurations of hardware, software, services and networks, including security configurations, are established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.purpose: Remove data that is no longer required.
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or other storage media is deleted when no longer required.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.purpose: Limit exposure of sensitive data values.
controls.description: Data masking is used in accordance with the access control policy and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.purpose: Stop sensitive information leaving without authority.
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures are applied to systems, networks and other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.purpose: Be able to restore information after loss.
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems are maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed backup policy.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.purpose: Meet availability requirements through redundancy.
controls.description: Information processing facilities are implemented with sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.

controls.title: Logging
controls.purpose: Record what happened for later analysis.
controls.description: Logs recording activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events are produced, stored, protected and analysed.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.purpose: Notice anomalous behaviour as it occurs.
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate action is taken to evaluate potential incidents.

controls.title: Clock synchronisation
controls.purpose: Make log timestamps comparable across systems.
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems are synchronised to approved time sources.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.purpose: Restrict tools that can bypass controls.
controls.description: The use of utility programs capable of overriding system and application controls is restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.purpose: Control what runs in production.
controls.description: Procedures and measures are implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.purpose: Protect information travelling over networks.
controls.description: Networks and network devices are secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.purpose: Define the security expected from each service.
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services are identified, implemented and monitored.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.purpose: Limit how far an intruder can move.
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems are segregated in the organisation's networks.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.purpose: Reduce exposure to malicious content.
controls.description: Access to external websites is managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.purpose: Apply encryption and key management consistently.
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, are defined and implemented.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.purpose: Build security into the way software is produced.
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems are established and applied.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.purpose: State security needs before building.
controls.description: Information security requirements are identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.purpose: Apply proven design principles.
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems are established, documented, maintained and applied to information system development activities.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.purpose: Avoid introducing vulnerabilities in code.
controls.description: Secure coding principles are applied to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.purpose: Verify security before release.
controls.description: Security testing processes are defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.purpose: Keep assurance over work done by others.
controls.description: The organisation directs, monitors and reviews the activities related to outsourced system development.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.purpose: Prevent non-production work affecting live systems.
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments are separated and secured.

controls.title: Change management
controls.purpose: Control change so security is not lost.
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems are subject to change management procedures.

controls.title: Test information
controls.purpose: Avoid exposing real data during testing.
controls.description: Test information is appropriately selected, protected and managed.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.purpose: Stop audit activity disrupting operations.
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems are planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
